steps.npc: Hi there [player name]. I am Falo the bard! Like my brother Olaf, who lives in Rellekka, I also write music.

steps.text: If the player has completed Fremennik Trials

steps.npc: Hi there [Fremennik name]. I am Falo the bard! Like my brother Olaf, who lives in Rellekka, I also write music.

standard-dialogue.player: Do you write about anything in particular?

standard-dialogue.npc: Oh most certainly! I write about all the objects in the lands. From weapons and armour to palm trees and sands. That's why I wander far from Rellekka to seek inspiration.
I have one problem though. I am very forgetful, I can never remember which particular object a song was about.

standard-dialogue.player: Surely the lyrics for such a song would be enough to help you remember?

standard-dialogue.npc: I am afraid not. It saddens me deeply, so I often send out messages to adventurers to help me discreetly.

standard-dialogue.player: I'll keep a look out for them! Goodbye Falo.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-has-not-.npc: Get away! I do not speak to outlanders.

treasure-trails-master.npc: Thank you for coming [Fremennik name], I need your help.
I have one of my old songs stuck in my head, but I cannot remember what the object it refers to is. I am so forgetful. I'll sing it to you.
Here goes... [one of his random songs]
You have very kind words. I would be extremely grateful if you could remind me which object the song was about.

treasure-trails-master-when-talked-to-ag.npc: I really hope you can help me. Please show me the object my song is about!

treasure-trails-master-when-talked-to-ag.player: Can you sing me the song again?

treasure-trails-master-when-the-correct-.text: You show your object to Falo.

treasure-trails-master-when-the-correct-.npc: Yes yes yes! That is it, thank you so much [Fremennik name]. The memories have come flooding back. I get why the lyrics are what they are now.

treasure-trails-master-when-the-correct-.text: You've been given a new clue!

treasure-trails-master-when-the-correct-.player: I'm glad to have helped, hopefully you'll never forget again!

treasure-trails-master-when-an-incorrect.text: You show your object to Falo.
Falo's eyes fail to light up.

treasure-trails-master-when-an-incorrect.npc: No no no! That's not it. Please have another think about it, [Fremennik name].
